item.ptxt: When a power window regulator motor assembly (any seat) is replaced with a new one, DTC B2313 is output. After resetting the power window (initializing the pulse sensor), clear the DTC.

When the door window regulator of any seat is replaced, or the power window regulator motor assembly (any seat) is removed from the door window regulator, it is necessary to return the power window regulator motor assembly (relevant seat) to the uninitialized state (clearing the current memory of the pulse sensor in the motor), then reset the glass position (initialize the pulse sensor). If the reset is not performed, the jam protection function may operate under conditions other than its operating conditions.

If AUTO UP is operated for a seat after replacing its glass, glass run, etc., the jam protection function may operate. In that case, holding AUTO UP until the door glass of the applicable seat is in the fully closed position will make that seat operate normally.
If the reset cannot be completed normally, LIN communication may be malfunctioning, so inspect the Body Multiplex Communication System [LIN] (see ).

s2.ptxt: Connect the battery and turn the ignition ON; at this time, the indicators of the power window regulator switch assembly, rear power window regulator switch assembly and power window regulator master switch assembly for the location where the power window regulator motor assembly was replaced or removed/installed blink, and the system enters the reset standby state.

item.ptxt: If the indicator does not blink and the jam protection function operates under conditions other than its operating conditions, perform the work below to return the power window regulator motor assembly (relevant seat) to the uninitialized state (clearing the current memory of the pulse sensor in the motor), and then perform the procedure.
While the power window of the relevant seat is operating, disconnect the power window regulator motor assembly (relevant seat) connector or disconnect the cable from the negative battery terminal.

s2.ptxt: After the glass is fully closed, operate the applicable seat switch on the power window regulator master switch assembly or the applicable seat power window switch for 1 seconds or more (hold AUTO UP); the power window (applicable seat) position is reset, the indicators of the power window regulator master switch assembly and the power window switch (applicable seat) change from blinking to illuminated, and the reset is complete.

atten4.ptxt: If the switch indicator does not change from blinking to illuminated even after performing the above operation, lower the glass 50 mm or more and perform the above operation again.
